original_failures.disposition: The new core subnormal conversion used a manually implemented leading-bit calculation. Replaced it with ilog2 after the explicit nonzero guard; exact exhaustive conversion coverage remains required.
A core test used a verbose zero-magnitude mask. Replaced it with the equivalent exact trailing-zero check; no input or expected-value coverage was removed.

The extended regression exposed a real reader gap: a schema-only Float16 file lost its typed empty RecordBatch before the buffered writer. Retained a typed batch for Float16 using the existing nested-schema path. Focused r2 passes the full source schema, all three writes/reopens and refusal after deliberate batch removal; final native workspace validation is required.

The new empty Float16 dictionary case reproduced the missing typed batch. Preserving both its dictionary Arrow hint and typed empty batch fixes the boundary; focused r4 passes all plain/dictionary/nested cases with both nullabilities and all three ingest modes, including refusal after batch removal.

Float16 admission made several primitive conversion arms identical and the previous Result/Option wrappers infallible. Merged identical arms and removed obsolete wrappers while retaining unsupported-domain and finite-value checks.

Compilation caught remaining callers of the now-infallible primitive conversion helpers. Updated the result builder, JSON writer and unary test call sites; the JSON finite-domain rejection remains explicit.
A CLI negative test asserted the previous F32/F64 diagnostic after the admitted set became F16/F32/F64. Updated only the expected diagnostic; the Variant rejection and no-fallback assertion remain.

The full Vortex test binary finished with one failure: the modified empty-input diagnostic no longer contained retaining field nullability. Restored the original nested wording and added a separate Float16 refusal. Extended the same regression to nullable/nonnullable empty Float16 inputs and all three ingest modes; final native workspace validation is required.

Deliberately interrupted through the unchanged supervisor after source review identified the empty Float16 dictionary boundary, so the corrected code could receive a fresh complete run. The process group drained. This is an incomplete observation, not a completed passing or failing native suite.

Compilation caught a missing test-only PType import and an obsolete unused trait import. Both were corrected; exhaustive owner tests are required in the final native workspace role. The original compile failure remains preserved.

Initial workflow run exposed harness assumptions about resources, workflow float policy, encoded Arrow dictionary admission, strict opaque carriage and independent tensor schema interpretation, plus NaN promotion and Avro preflight gaps. Corrected against existing contracts without relaxing complete-value checks; final float16_bindings and installed roles must pass all 14 tests.

Isolated two implementation defects: provider Float16-to-Float64 promotion quieted signaling NaNs, and Avro widened Float16 before a late reopen refusal. Selected promotion now uses the exact-bit numeric owner and recursive Avro/ORC preflight occurs before producer execution. Final binding and installed roles prove both fixes.

New controls exposed absent strict finite validation at the direct promotion writer and an incorrect nullable COALESCE reference schema. Promotion now validates selected valid values and final cancellation; the reference reflects the nonnullable default while preserving exact bit checks. Final binding and native workspace roles require these controls.
